E1275

Build sandboxing is required but unavailable.

What

Build sandboxing is required but unavailable.

Why

D-JPK-SANDBOX2 permits non-executing reuse and trusted substitution, but a local executable action needs the native child boundary. Jetpack refuses to launch it when the platform cannot enforce that boundary.

Fix

Provide a trusted substitute or approved remote builder, or enable the native sandbox, then retry.
